name: Love In The Woods
source:
First impressions matter...
Love in the Woods is a visual novel set 4 years after the events of Night in the Woods. You are invited to Mae's house for dinner and to celebrate Longest Night. What will you do?

[From [url=https://love-in-the-woods.itch.io/love-in-the-woods-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
第一印象很重要…
《林中之恋》是一部视觉小说，背景设定在《林中之夜》事件发生四年后。你被邀请到梅家吃晚饭并庆祝最长的一夜。你会怎么做？

[来自[url=https://love-in-the-woods.itch.io/love-in-the-woods-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
